beats.text: Here is the whole network, redrawn. The image goes into **both** encoders at the same time.
Mamba makes three skip maps: **sixty-four**, thirty-two, and sixteen pixels wide.
SAM gives three maps, all **sixteen** by sixteen.
H C E M upsamples the SAM map to the size of the skip, and **concatenates** them.
A gate looks at the average and the maximum of every channel, and turns the **volume** of each channel up or down.
The result is concatenated with the skip once more, and goes into the **decoder**.
That happens three times, from coarse to fine, and then one last layer gives the **mask**.
